testResults.name: bootstrap-runbook-contract
testResults.result: All 23 required bootstrap topics are present, including reusable dev/prod profiles, nine provider namespaces, immutable subjects, GitHub variables, package permissions, Key Vault seeding/rotation, validation, rollback, and plan limitations.

testResults.name: markdown-and-secret-safety
commands: PowerShell static parser over 17 fenced PowerShell blocks
testResults.result: Markdownlint reported zero errors, all 17 PowerShell blocks parsed, and unsafe inline-secret patterns were absent.

testResults.name: hosted-current-state
testResults.result: The current immutable OIDC deployment path passed image publication, Azure login, Bicep deployment, digest verification, and private health smoke.

decisions: Dev records exact current values; prod uses explicit placeholders until its subscription, network, budget, schedule, approval, and credentials are approved.
Required reviewers remain unsupported for this private personal repository plan; the current dev protection is the master-only Environment branch policy.
limitations: Direct private GHCR package metadata retrieval was unavailable to the current gh token; package behavior is proven by workflow permissions and hosted import/deployment.
